data.narrative: Devanshi mastered structured logging analysis, resolving hardcoded log level overrides and UTC timezone boundary bugs. Successfully recognized logs as a critical security trust boundary by diagnosing and neutralizing a Log Injection vulnerability (CWE-117).

dimension_scores.observation: Formed accurate hypotheses for missing request logs and midnight timezone rollover issues.
dimension_scores.evidence: Tested logger config priority and UTC vs local time in module-02-diagnosis.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Read structured JSON logs as a chronological story, noticing missing intake frames and embedded forged log lines.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified r-102 forged admin login inside r-101 request body.

dimension_scores.observation: Reconstructed midnight boundary conditions across differing timezone offsets.
dimension_scores.evidence: Simulated UTC midnight queries against non-UTC database rows.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained clean, detailed diagnosis notes distinguishing symptoms, hypotheses, and fixes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Recorded structured diagnosis notes in progress/module-02-diagnosis.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that logs represent an external trust boundary requiring input sanitization.
dimension_scores.evidence: Neutralized log injection by escaping newlines and enforcing strict JSON encoding.

dimension_scores.observation: Proposed watchdog log checks to detect timezone drift between application and database.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented watchdog comparison strategy in diagnosis notes.

strengths: Exceptional log literacy: quickly caught synthetic log frames lacking request correlation IDs
Recognized that log files are an input trust boundary subject to injection attacks
data.recommendation: In Module 3, focus on isolating race conditions and flaky failures under automated load testing.
